entries.zh: 央求；恳托人办事、托人说情
entries.en: to entreat, beg someone to act or intercede

entries.zh: 说人情；替人讲情、说好话求情
entries.en: to plead on another's behalf; to appeal to personal favor for someone

entries.zh: 求人情；托人情、请人关照
entries.en: to ask a favor of someone; to seek another's good offices

entries.zh: 提携；扶持提掖、助人上进
entries.en: to lead by the hand; to guide, support and promote someone

entries.zh: 提撕；提点扶持（经典中亦作警省教诲讲）
entries.en: to take up and help someone along; to admonish, rouse to attention
entries.notes: 提撕经典义偏警省教诲，与 L 栏 interceder 契合较松，取提携扶持为主义并附教诲义。

entries.zh: 提挈；提携照顾、拉拔帮助
entries.en: to take by the hand; to assist and look after someone

entries.zh: 说方便；替人讨情面、求通融
entries.en: to ask for indulgence on someone's behalf; to plead that a matter be made easy

entries.zh: 解释；就难处分说、排解疑难（por dificultad）
entries.en: to explain, expound; to talk a difficulty away, smooth it over

entries.zh: 央托；恳托、托人情（同上：interceder）
entries.en: to entrust a matter entreatingly; to ask through another (same as above, interceder)

entries.zh: 央求；苦苦恳求
entries.en: to entreat, beg earnestly

entries.zh: 牵荐；引荐美言、代为举荐
entries.en: to recommend someone with a good word; to put in a good word
entries.notes: 牵荐为罕见连用，依 L 栏 informando bien（说好话举荐）定其义。

entries.zh: 帮助；扶助、襄助
entries.en: to help, aid, assist
entries.notes: 助廷字组罕见，M 音 chan iēn 与字面不尽合、疑有讹字，据 L 栏 ayudar 定为相助义。

entries.zh: 央得着人；靠情分求得肯代为央恳之人
entries.en: to have secured someone to intercede, through friendship and prevailing on him to ask
entries.notes: L 栏 el f. 缩写展开存疑（或为 fuerte/favor），据词头定为托得动人代求义。

entries.zh: 鄙：鄙陋可鄙、鄙贱
entries.en: base, mean, contemptible
entries.notes: L 栏 Yntelessable 拼写不明（疑讹），释义以鄙字本义为主。

entries.zh: 张：张开、伸展；亦作施设、摆布讲
entries.en: to stretch, spread, open; to set out, arrange
entries.notes: L 栏 [空]，单字义项未定，取张字本义开张伸展为主。

entries.zh: 刁难：存心留难、作梗勒掯（唯利而为，参见贪婪）
entries.en: to make difficulties, obstruct; grasping, acting only out of self-interest (cf. codicia, greed)
entries.notes: L 栏含 gf. 缩写与唯利旁注（solo obra por interes），展开未定，刁难义与旁注并录。

entries.zh: 传：传话、转达；充当传译
entries.en: to transmit, relay a message; to interpret
entries.notes: M 栏 toān da 多出一音节、疑第二字未录，据 L 栏 Ynterprete 定为传话传译义。

entries.zh: 解：解说、开解；亦指解开、解散
entries.en: to explain, expound; to unravel, undo
entries.notes: L 栏 [空]，此条居传译诸条之间，取解说义为主兼列解开义。

entries.zh: 通事：通译、翻译，代传言语的中间人
entries.en: interpreter (t'ung-shih); go-between who interprets, as in trade
entries.notes: L 栏 nagna tac 语义不明（疑讹写或他语记音），据通事本义定为通译。

entries.zh: 回话：答话、回覆；代为传话
entries.en: to reply, answer back; to relay an answer for someone (interpret)
